# National Scaffold - LLMs.txt
# https://nationalscaffold.co.uk

## Business
National Scaffold is England's fixed-price scaffolding network connecting customers with vetted professional scaffolding contractors for residential and commercial projects.

## Services
- Fixed price residential scaffolding
- Fixed price commercial scaffolding
- Roof scaffolding
- Chimney scaffolding
- Extension scaffolding
- Gutter and fascia scaffolding
